reason: Color tokens are declared once as light-dark(light, dark). getPropertyValue() returns the unresolved light-dark(...) text, alone or inside a composite value such as a box-shadow, where 2.1.1 returned the per-scheme literal. About 84 color tokens. What the tokens resolve to is compared separately (kind token) and must match.
notes: Seed from PLAN. Broad on purpose; later phases may narrow token to the converted color tokens.

reason: A user stylesheet with ':root { --femto-primary: ... }' now takes effect. In 2.1.1 it lost to ':root:not([data-theme=dark])' at specificity (0,2,0); femto declares tokens on ':root, :host' at (0,1,0).
notes: Seed from PLAN. Applies only to a comparison preset named user-root-override that loads a user override stylesheet after both sides; no such preset exists yet.

reason: Same cause as tokens-root-user-override-style: the user's :root override of the primary tokens now wins, so the tokens resolve to the user's values.

New tokens replace Sass function arguments and a compile-time @if: --femto-box-shadow-color (shadow() helper), --femto-primary-inverse-filter (the loading spinner filter chosen by comparing primary-inverse to white), --femto-switch-width and --femto-switch-height (switch Sass locals).
